name: Brambling's Bakehouse
story: Maud bakes for the whole of Merrowby and knows what everyone eats, which is the same as knowing everything. The first loaf goes on the Toll's rim-stone every morning and is still there at noon, and she will not say why, and neither will anyone else.
who_was_here: Her husband, an unreliable huntsman, whose coat is still on the door hook.
unique_object: a coat on a hook by the door belonging to a man who has been gone nine years
